title: Gift Emoji: Copy & Paste 🎁 Present & Surprise Combos
meta_description: Copy and paste the gift emoji 🎁, wrapping and ribbon symbols 🎀 💝, and surprise combos 🎉 🥳 ✨ for birthdays and any occasion. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The wrapped gift, ribbon and wrapping symbols, and the surprise-and-celebration emoji that go with any present. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: 🎁 is the emoji for presents of every kind — birthdays, "just because" surprises, thank-you gifts, and every gift-giving moment that isn't tied to a single holiday. This page covers that general, year-round set: the wrapped gift and its ribbon-and-wrapping cousins, the surprise-and-celebration emoji that usually ride along with it, and occasion-neutral party symbols you can pair with any present. If you're specifically decorating a Christmas post, the gifts-and-Santa section on the Christmas symbols page below is the holiday-themed version of this same glyph — this page is the everyday, any-occasion one.
